hook: Stop feeling bad about a week off. Your dog saved you a gift.
away: You took a week off. I waited. And napped. Mostly napped.
letter: When you come back, Gerald sends a letter. A treat bag and a hundred coins. Welcome back!
diary: And I kept a diary for you. I sat by the gate and listened for your footsteps. I found a sock. It's mine now.
gift: Plus a little gift from me, once a day. Today, carrot sticks. I only sniffed them.
days: The game counts every day you play. It never resets. Miss a day? Nothing lost.
mile: And Gerald has gifts at seven, thirty, a hundred, and three hundred sixty-five days.
end: No streaks. No guilt. Just a happy dog. Tag someone who needs a break!
